page_title: EIN 1-0 WER | Eintracht Frankfurt v Werder Bremen 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+3' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
90+2' Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Hugo Ekitike cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
86' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) replaces Senne Lynen.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) will replace Niklas Stark.
85' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
85' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
83' Looks like Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
82' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is caught offside!
81' It's time for a substitution. Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Mario Gotze.
81' Here is a change. Omar Marmoush is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
81' A player from Werder Bremen commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
80' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
80' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
77' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) replacing Derrick Kohn.
77' Leonardo Bittencourt will be replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
77' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florian Badstubner blows for a foul.
77' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
77' The corner kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

76' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Kevin Trapp dived superbly to block a header by Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Kevin Trapp pulled off a remarkable save!
75' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
72' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
71' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
68' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

67' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
67' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the corner.
66' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
66' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Michael Zetterer.
65' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches a cross from the corner, but Michael Zetterer is alert to thwart the effort.
64' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch so that Marco Grull can be given a rest.
63' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
62' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
61' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
60' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for a foul. Florian Badstubner had a clear view and blows his whistle.
56' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
54' What was Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
54' The corner from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared away by the defence.
53' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
49' Ole Werner is stunned as referee Florian Badstubner shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
48' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) commits a rough foul. Florian Badstubner stops the game and makes a call.
48' A short pass finds Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
47' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' 1 - 0 Goal! Hugo Ekitike shows great vision to find Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the roof of the net. 1:0.
43' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
41' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
40' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
38' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
35' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) passes the ball onto Romano Schmid, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
32' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen).
31' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Florian Badstubner who sees an offensive foul.
28' The game is interrupted as Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is flagged offside.
27' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
27' Marvin Ducksch sends the corner into the box, but Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) intercepts it and averts the threat.
27' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
25' Foul! Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
24' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' Florian Badstubner blows for a foul after Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
22' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the left post.
21' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
21' Derrick Kohn receives a sweet cross inside the box from Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
16' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too forceful with his tackle and Florian Badstubner interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
15' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) heads on.

13' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets inside the box and tries to beat Michael Zetterer with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
12' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
12' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
11' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
10' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
10' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
9' A clumsy foul by Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle.
8' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and it's Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

6' Great save! Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Michael Zetterer.
5' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
1' The first half has started.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
